scope: Read-only audit of active NutSort gameplay/business flows; design only. No code, Prefab or gameplay changes.
existingBusinessAnalyticsFinding: No Track/BTrack/ThinkingData business event invocation was found under Assets/NutSort. CloseTrack is an animation struct, not analytics.

existingSDKEntryCalls.note: SDK handles ad telemetry separately; not a business Track invocation.
SDK handles ad telemetry separately; avoid duplicating SDK ad events.

identityDefinitions.level_id: Recommended: snapshot User.Level for the raw progression round before it increments. Keep it fixed on the attempt; never read live User.Level for a previous-round end/reward.
identityDefinitions.display_level: Tables.GetShowLevel(level_id). Player-visible level can contain several raw rounds.
identityDefinitions.content_level_id: User.LevelId is the selected content/catalog ID, not the progression or displayed level.
identityDefinitions.tutorial_step: For legacy tutorial User.Level==1, LevelSeed selects stages 0,1,2,3. It is NOT retry number.
identityDefinitions.attempt_id: New persisted unique ID per actual fresh board attempt; retain on saved-board resume; allocate only once after successful ready, not every InitLevel call.
identityDefinitions.attempt_no: Separate analytics counter per raw round/tutorial stage; increment only on fresh replay/failure retry, do not derive from LevelSeed or ScrewMoveCount.
identityDefinitions.seed: If needed capture LevelSelection.SeedIndex/Seed when chosen; User.LevelSeed is not actual selected seed in random mode.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: A real gameplay board is ready and not merely showing a previously pending reward.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: LocalGameplayController.OnBoardReady after LocalPendingReward early return; record once per new attempt. Resume retains attempt ID and should not count a second start.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.caution: Do not instrument every BeginInitialization/RebuildBoard. Multiple pending initializations and automatic resume reconstruction exist. Board-ready is not necessarily the first input-enabled frame; specify this as the event definition.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: One terminal outcome for an attempt.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: Win: first succeeded state transition in OriginalSuccessFlow.Run, before tutorial seed or User.Level changes. Fail: first OriginalFailureFlow.IsFail false-to-true. Manual replay: accepted OriginalReplayPanel.Replay/OriginalGameScene.RestartLevel, only if no terminal outcome exists.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.dedupe: attempt_id:end; never emit both fail and restart for the failed attempt; next start uses origin=failure_retry.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.caution: Do not emit win at reward popup or reward claim; popup can re-open from pending settlement. App pause is not a quit and may be caused by an ad.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: Welcome and the four actual teaching stages, on entry/completion only.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: Welcome open and accepted Start; teaching stage entry keyed by LevelSeed 0..3. Completion at actual success transition: 0..2 increment seed, final stage advances User.Level to 2.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.dedupe: Persisted tutorial_id + step_id + status; RefreshTeaching/Teaching.Run/CloseTeaching can be called repeatedly and are not standalone completion evidence.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: Committed local game balance/inventory change; one event per changed resource with signed delta.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: Tools: OriginalItemManager after count mutation and save returns. Level rewards: LocalCashSettlement.Claim true and local persist completed, capture exact pending amounts first. Tutorial balance: separately capture actual max(new,old)-old delta and save success.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.dedupe: transaction_id + resource; store once-only ledger with same local state checkpoint. Do not also emit equivalent resource gain from the SDK reward callback or visual fly animation.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.caution: Refresh mode entry does not consume a tool; actual selected-rod exchange does. Ad callback success may grant then immediately spend undo/add_screw. Record both real deltas, not a zero net balance. Local cash is not a paid withdrawal or ad revenue.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: OpenLocalWithdrawal/OpenDiamondWithdrawal only after guarded new panel creation, not every Refresh.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.dedupe: One per panel-open instance; reopening is a legitimate new view.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: User intent and client-side requirement outcome, never backend payment success.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: Accepted cash/diamond withdrawal action; conditions continue; final local account confirmation. Stage enum can replace many duplicated click-only event names.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.caution: Do not emit submitted, processing or success: ConfirmLocalWithdrawal only rechecks eligibility and displays service text. No backend request/order ID exists.

recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.meaning: Accepted form confirmation and local validation/save result.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.trigger: OriginalWithdrawalUserInfoFlow.Get validation branches or after local save returns.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.dedupe: Once per accepted form attempt, not keyboard changes or every Refresh. A later deliberate edit/save is a new form attempt.
recommendedMinimalBusinessEvents.caution: Never include name, phone number, email, full account JSON, or freeform text. Local save is not server submission/verification/payment.

toolConsumptionEvidence.note: Only after inventory/history checks, actual revoke then AddTool(-1).
Selecting the rod performs reorder and AddTool(3,-1) at line269; entering/cancelling exchange is not use.
After max/inventory checks and unlock/add world operation, AddTool(4,-1) at34.
SDK completion passes request/board guards. Actual grant exists at ApplyToolRefill:101; don't emit grant at ad-request/offer-open.

removeOrDefer: No new check-in/sign-in or skin/cosmetic events; active login-day calendar does not constitute a check-in reward feature.
No revive success/continue-by-ad event: LocalGameplayController.Failure.cs:16-21 explicitly excludes SDK revive from active local UI.
No generic application_pause -> level_exit mapping; advertisements/backgrounding generate pauses. There is no active explicit quit-level action in Runtime.
No withdrawal_submit_success/payment_success/server_verification_success until an authoritative asynchronous backend response/order ID exists.
Do not log reward again at Prepare, success UI show, animation completion or SDK reward callback when resource_change already logs committed balance.
Do not duplicate SDK ad request/show/reward/revenue events from business code; SDK audit is owned separately.

countingAndDurationRisks.finding: ScrewMoveCount is lifetime attempted moves and increments before destination validity. It is neither successful moves nor per-attempt count.
PassLevelTime increments whenever IsInitDone, including modal time. Label it round elapsed time; do not call it active interaction time without a separate timer definition.
OnApplicationPause currently only saves; it provides no reliable level-exit intent.
Pending reward currently has country, amount, nextLevel and optional diamonds, but no durable transaction_id. A dedupe design must add an analytics ID if implemented later, not pretend it exists now.

implementationConstraintsIfApproved: Use typed business notifications to the default-assembly integration bridge; runtime asmdefs cannot directly reference Assembly-CSharp SDKAdapter.
Do not modify Assets/SDK to add business tracking.
Instrument only low-frequency transitions, no per-frame Track, UI-refresh Track or per-move uploads.
Persist attempt/transaction IDs and dispatch state; SDK queue/retry behavior alone is not proof of end-to-end exactly-once business delivery.
